title: Create a floor slab of a named type from a closed footprint on a level
task: Put a floor under an enclosed footprint: build a closed CurveLoop of Line segments, pick a FloorType by name (fallback Floor.GetDefaultFloorType) and call Floor.Create(document, loops, floorTypeId, levelId); verify the level and the sketch area.

pitfalls.symptom: Floor.Create throws ArgumentException about the profile.
pitfalls.cause: The CurveLoop is open (a segment's end does not meet the next segment's start) or not planar.
pitfalls.fix: Build the loop from consecutive points so each segment ends where the next begins (step 2); keep all points at one Z.

pitfalls.symptom: The chosen floor type is a foundation slab, or the named type is missing.
pitfalls.cause: FloorType covers both floors and structural foundations; names are template-dependent.
pitfalls.fix: Filter with !ft.IsFoundationSlab and fall back to Floor.GetDefaultFloorType(doc, false) (step 1).
